name: Amatitlán
summary: 25.2 MWe installed capacity — 3 units (2×12 MW + 1×1.2 MW), online since 2007
detail: A deep 285°C Na-Cl reservoir with upflow concentrated around the AMF-2/AMF-6 area, magmatically heated by the active Pacaya volcano and structurally controlled by overlapping caldera faults and a post-caldera dacite intrusion. The wellfield currently runs 5 active production wells plus 1 idle (AMF-1RD, AMF-2, AMF-5, AMF-6, AMF-8) feeding the plant, with 2 active injectors (AMF-3, AMF-4) returning fluid northward along the outflow path. Field pressure drew down fast in 2007–09 immediately after startup; the original AMF-1 then suffered scaling and mechanical failures through 2009–13, AMF-8 lost productivity over the same period, and its replacement AMF-1RD has needed recurring mechanical and acid cleaning for calcite scale since 2013.
